task: Unified diff + patch + three-way merge toolkit differentially tested against GNU diff, patch and diff3
reasoning_summary: Minimal LCS line diff feeds a GNU-identical unified-diff writer, a strict parser, an offset-searching patcher with reject/reverse, and a cluster-based diff3-style merge. Behaviours were pinned by probing GNU diff3 first (touching changes conflict, identical changes are clean here) and then checked by differential tests on unique-line generators plus algebraic properties. A 21-mutant pass initially left 4 survivors that were closed with a message assertion, two missing fixtures and a larger performance input.
